Sentiment is the closest call: operating income fell "(0.2) %" and "(1.7) %", but every characterization the filer makes is favorable ("strong sales", "continued strength in member engagement", "disciplined inventory management"), so the lean is positive; I did not add LEGAL_REGULATORY_ACTION for "higher self-insured general liability claims expense" because no action, investigation or proceeding is named.

Sentiment is POSITIVE despite EPS falling to "$0.55 ... compared to $1.00", because the filer's characterization controls: "maintained strong momentum", "business fundamentals are robust", "record total orders"; guidance is MAINTAINED on "Reiterating full year revenue guidance of 14-16% growth" and "Reiterating non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance of $4.00 to $4.20".

A GAAP-to-segment reconciliation ("This analysis reconciles the summarized components of Total Segments ... to their equivalent GAAP measures") is mechanical disclosure with no characterization and no taxonomy language.

The double label follows the regulation-driven-cost rule: "incremental costs of complying with the new European Union medical device regulations" is an existing regulation plus an already-incurred cost, and "Certain litigation charges ... 168" independently supports the legal flag; IMPAIRMENT_WRITEDOWN rests on "The net charge relates to the exit of businesses and is primarily comprised of intangible asset impairments."

Sentiment is the uncertain field: much of the passage is neutral product architecture description, but the filer's own characterizations lean favorable — "continued demand for our software products", "the high percentage of customers that renew", "differentiates us from many of our competitors".

I withheld MARGIN_COST_PRESSURE because the cost increase is volume-driven content amortization ("a $362 million increase in content amortization relating to our existing and new content") and the ratio is explicitly unchanged — "As a percentage of revenues 58 % 58 %" — so no margin compression or cost-inflation language is asserted.

IMPAIRMENT_WRITEDOWN is the less certain flag, resting on the quantified line "Asset Impairment & Exit Costs (1) (23) (20)" rather than narrative; I did not flag SUPPLY_INPUT_CONSTRAINT because the shortage named is a competitor's — "pandemic-related supply-chain shortages involving competitors' products" — and a market-wide disruption is not automatically this filer's own constraint.

No IMPAIRMENT_WRITEDOWN because the passage is impairment-testing methodology plus an explicit negation — "We did not recognize material impairment on goodwill or intangible assets in 2015, 2014 or 2013" — with no charge asserted and no risk asserted.
